RACCOON RECYCLER - Windows testing build

Press A to start. Left and Right select the side bins. Down or Up selects the
centre bin. The junction stays selected until you change it.
Each toy is judged when it reaches the fork. Correct sorts earn 1 point.
One wrong sort ends your run. There are no hearts or extra lives.

Nine objects: ducks, sea stars and snails in yellow, white or blue. Snail colour
is the colour of its shell. Read the pictures on the bins: neutral animals mean
sort by species; plain rectangles mean sort by colour. Animal and colour orders
reshuffle at every rule change, so always read the current bin signs.
A chime announces the new rule and order. The belt
clears completely and delivery pauses before the rule changes.

The conveyor doubles its speed over the first 72 deliveries. Objects arrive
every 1.6 seconds initially, every 0.8 seconds after 36 deliveries, and every
0.6 seconds at maximum pace. They also sit closer together on the belt.
P2-P4 press A on the title to join (B leaves). Everyone shares the incoming toys,
but controls their own coloured junction and is scored independently. Overlapping
junction strips show players choosing the same side. Each raccoon stays full size.
Select or Start pauses the run. A returns from results to the title.

Keyboard: P1 arrows, X=A, Z=B; P2 A/D for sides, W/S for centre, H=A, G=B.
Keyboard supports two players; SDL controllers support four using D-pad and A. Best scores save beside the executable.

MIT code; game artwork and music CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. See bundled license files.
